label: weak sparse feature: j/a/<DEL> inputs in k/j-initial sequences rich in b,m,q,w,0
explanation: Very sparse (0.03% of steps), low-magnitude feature. Never fires at t=0-1 and does not fire after a copy error. Activations concentrate on inputs j (39% of mass), a (15%) and <DEL> (20%), on outputs k/j, in sequences whose first token is k or j (58% of mass), and on steps preceded by b, m, q, w or 0. Each of these cues is common in sequences where the feature is silent: no conjunction reached precision above about 6%, and the best predicate scored dev F1 0.05 (mass recall 0.30). Activations are spread fairly evenly across quartiles; none of the cues clearly sets magnitude. The recorded predicate is a weak description, not an explanation.
